senses.gloss: भग्न- + आश भग्न- + आश (vb. भञ्ज्), adj. disappointed.
भगवद्गीता भगवद्गीता, i. e. भगवन्त्-, f. the name of an episode of the Mahābhārata.
भग्न- + दर्प भग्न- + दर्प (vb. भञ्ज्), adj. humbled.

भग भग, i. e. भज् and भञ्ज् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. The sun.
 2. Śiva.
 II. n.
 1. Divine power.
 2. Fortune.
 3. Virtue.
 4. Beauty.
 5. Pudendum muliebre, Rājat. 5, 282.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Goth. ga-bigs.

भाग भाग, i. e. भज् + अ, m.
 1. A portion, part, Pañc. i. d. 447; side, Vikr. d. 26; Utt. Rāmac. 42, 12.
 2. Fortune, fate, Utt. Rāmac. 38, 9.
 3. A division of time, the 30th part [] of a zodiacal sign.
 4. A degree, the 360th part of the circumference of a great circle.
 --Comp.
भगदत्त भग-दत्त (vb. दा), m. A proper name.
भगनेत्र भग-नेत्र, m. The name of a demon, Johns. Sel. 97, 80.

भगवन्त् भग + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, Adorable, Man. 1, 6; Vikr. 31, 18; 85, 21; respectable, worshipful (used in address), Chr. 17, 27; Pañc. 80, 13.
 II. f. वती, A name of Gaurī.
भगाल भगाल, n. The human skull.
भगालिन् भगालिन्, i. e. भगाल + इन्, m. A name of Śiva.

भगिनी भगिनी, i. e. भग + इन् + ई, f.
 1. A sister, Pañc. 214, 25; 222, 9.
 2. A woman in general.
 --Comp.
भगीरथ भगीरथ, m. A king whose austerities brought Gaṅgā, the river, from heaven; called her father, Rām. 1, 44, 8 sqq. Gorr.; Utt. Rāmac. 167, 10; Chr. 24, 47.
भगोस् भगोस्, an old voc. sing. of भगवन्त्, indecl. A particle used as respectful address.

भागधेय भाग-धेय (vb. धा),
 I. m.
 1. A heir.
 2. Royal revenue.
 II. n.
 1. Portion, Man. 3, 245.
 2. Fate, fortune, happiness, Vikr. 55, 10.
भागशस् भाग + शस्, adv. Part for part, MBh. 2, 211; Man. 12, 22 (Jones: In the order of their natural distribution.)

भागिन् भागिन्, i. e. भज् and भाग + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Who or what shares.
 2. One who partakes, Man. 3, 143; Pañc. 16, 2.
 3. Undergoing, suffering, Pañc. 29, 9; 68, 23.
 4. An [] owner, Man. 9, 48.
 5. Consisting of parts.
 II. m. A co-heir.
 III. f. नी, Co-heiress.
 --Comp.

भागिनेय भागिनेय, i. e. भगिनी + एय,
 I. m. A sister's son, Pañc. 231, 20.
 II. यी, A sister's daughter.
भागीरथी भागीरथी, i. e. भगिरथ + अ + ई, f. The Ganges. Hit. 3, 3, M.M.

भाग्य भाग्य, i. e. भाग + य, n.
 1. Merit and demerit acquired in former existences, fate, fortune, Vikr. 63, 19.
 2. Merit, Bhartṛ. 2, 94.
 3. Happiness, Hit. pr. d. 5, M.M.
 4. instr. येन, Happily, Hit. 17, 4, M.M.
 5. Sensual pleasure, Rājat. 5, 385.
 --Comp.

भाग्यवन्त् भाग्य + वन्त्, adj.
 1. Abounding in merits.
 2. Happy, Pañc. 201, 7.
भाग्य- + विपर्यय भाग्य- + विपर्यय, and विधि-, m. misfortune, Vikr. 63, 19; 69, 9.
भाग्य- + वृत्ति भाग्य- + वृत्ति, f. state of fortune, fortune, Rājat. 5, 261. []
